request.style: English, female solo vocal, emotional and pleading, piano, strings, cello, soft drums, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
For your sake we are killed all day
Regarded as sheep for the slaughter
Awake Lord why do you sleep
Rouse yourself do not reject us

[Chorus]
Rise up and help us
Redeem us for your steadfast love
Rise up and help us
Our soul is sunk down to the dust

[Verse]
Why do you hide your face
Forget our affliction and oppression
Our body clings to the ground
We wait for your faithful hand

[Chorus]
Rise up and help us
Redeem us for your steadfast love
Rise up and help us
Our soul is sunk down to the dust

[Bridge]
We are regarded as sheep
Waiting for the dawn to break
Do not forget our cries
Remember our suffering pain

[Chorus]
Rise up and help us
Redeem us for your steadfast love
Rise up and help us
Our soul is sunk down to the dust

[Outro]
Rise up and help us
Redeem us for your steadfast love
